plan.note: All valid samples retained; two independently balanced blocks; A/A interleaved with A/B.
plan.duration_rule: Same frame count per pair, calibrated to mean baseline/candidate duration of at least five seconds; calibration excluded from estimates.

interval_method: 20,000 paired bootstrap resamples in log-ratio space, stratified by the two blocks; no samples removed. ci98_75 is a Bonferroni-adjusted interval for four wall-time cases. Intervals do not cover systematic machine/session effects.
